globalNews.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
globalNews.summary: Iranian media reports two children were among those killed when shrapnel hit a home. Iran then launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.

globalNews.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
globalNews.summary: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.

globalNews.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
globalNews.summary: The Russian president wants to keep Britain guessing - and stressing - over Moscow's real intentions.

globalNews.title: US sailors arrive in Thailand's Pattaya after record 250 days at sea
globalNews.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln is docking close to Pattaya, known for its neon-lit nightlife, and for sex tourism.

globalNews.title: Woman charged with juror intimidation in Lindsay Clancy trial
globalNews.summary: Dawn Light is accused of taking photos of jurors outside the Plymouth courthouse, a practice prohibited by the court.

cryptoNews.title: Ondo urges SEC, CFTC to bring US stock perpetuals onshore
cryptoNews.summary: Ondo says existing US securities laws can accommodate perpetual futures tied to individual stocks as regulators look to bring more derivatives activity onshore.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin’s apparent demand turns negative as price struggles with $77K
cryptoNews.summary: One of Bitcoin’s onchain demand indicators turns negative again after a brief August rebound, as BTC price slipped below $77,000 amid a broader bond and equities sell-off.

cryptoNews.title: G20 members tout ‘clear pathways’ for digital asset innovation
cryptoNews.summary: Officials in the G20, under the US’ presidency, recognized that digital assets could support “broad-based economic growth” and called for improvements in cross-border transactions.

cryptoNews.title: Sui DeFi protocol Full Sail to wind down after Switchboard incident
cryptoNews.summary: Full Sail is shutting down after an attacker removed about $91,000 from three vaults during a security incident linked to oracle provider Switchboard.

cryptoNews.title: BTC will hit $1M by 2030... but Arthur Hayes is buying ETH instead
cryptoNews.summary: Arthur Hayes says Bitcoin is going to grind higher from here, but Ethereum is his number one pick due to its potential to increase “3x to 5x pretty quickly.”

aiNews.title: Wonderful more than doubles its valuation to $5B in under 6 months
aiNews.summary: Wonderful said it will use its $550 million Series C funding to develop products faster, expand its FDE teams, and meet demand for its products.

aiNews.title: India’s richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs
aiNews.summary: Jio is betting it can turn an aging computer into an AI-ready PC for as little as about $11 for two months.

aiNews.title: HiddenLayer nabs $100M as enterprises rush to secure their AI deployments
aiNews.summary: Security companies are scrambling to build products that can monitor not just agents but also the tools and add-ons they use.

aiNews.title: PSA: Amazon’s shopping AI can now tell you if that message is a scam
aiNews.summary: Amazon is adding a scam-detection feature to Alexa for Shopping that can verify whether suspicious emails, texts, and other messages actually came from the retailer.

aiNews.title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
aiNews.summary: This is Adobe's second acquisition out of India after Rephrase.ai in 2023
